vectorTiles._comment: Vector tiles DISARMED (R.45/R.38 sprint — R.33, backlog résiduel S5, 25/07/2026). This block declared enabled:true without `tilesUrl`, which promised MVT the runtime never served: shouldUseVectorTiles() (capabilities/vector-tiles/vector-tiles.ts) requires an ABSOLUTE url and deliberately refuses the relative path derived from `tilesDirectory`, because the .pbf files may not exist. The layer therefore fell back to GeoJSON — silently, with no warning. The promise is disarmed rather than deleted: re-arming means adding a real `tilesUrl` and setting enabled back to true.
